description: Do not start the rmm audio capture thread (entry 0x36cf8, literal at vaddr 0x2c698): replace the bl pthread_create at vaddr 0x2c218 with mov r0,#0 so main sees success and continues. No mic capture, speex preprocessing or AAC encoding runs. The pthread_t slot at sp+32 is not read again in main.
source_reference: docs/research/rmm.md, Ways to modify rmm, patch C
